raw_posts.name: Youkti
raw_posts.tagline: Finds who's ready to buy, then tells you what to do next
raw_posts.description: Youkti keeps a memory of every account, conversation, and deal, then tells your sales team the exact next move: which deal is slipping, which dormant account just fired a signal, what to prep for tomorrow's meeting. Built for AEs, RevOps, and outbound reps. Contact data, buying signals, and intent are all free, no card, no meter.

raw_posts.name: Cortex
raw_posts.tagline: Turn API specs into docs, SDKs, and MCP servers
raw_posts.description: Cortex is an open source API knowledge layer that turns OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, and OpenRPC specs into interactive documentation, typed SDKs in 11 languages, and MCP servers for AI agents.

raw_posts.name: QApilot MCP for Android
raw_posts.tagline: Android app testing inside your coding agent
raw_posts.description: QApilot MCP automates tests on real Android devices and emulators by talking to Claude, Cursor or Codex. Describe a test flow in plain English, no Appium code required. Your agent lays out the steps. QApilot runs the steps. It finds the elements, waits for the screen to settle, retries when something moves, and caches what it learns so repeat runs are faster. Every pass saves a Gherkin feature file and becomes a replayable test case. Needs Node, Java and the Android SDK.

raw_posts.name: ABrush
raw_posts.description: ABrush brings leading AI models and production-ready advanced AI workflows into the environment where artists already work. We use AI to remove repetitive production work, accelerate iteration, and give artists more time for creative decisions, while keeping the artist in control of the final result. AI speeds up the process and cuts the cost of routine. Created by artists, for artists.

raw_posts.name: Calerto for Mac
raw_posts.tagline: Full-screen meeting alerts for your Mac
raw_posts.description: Calerto turns your calendar into alarms you can't sleep through. Full-screen meeting alerts — not another notification you'll swipe away — with custom prep time per meeting, Apple + Google Calendar sync, a menu bar countdown to what's next, and automatic launch at login (toggle it off anytime). Pause alarms without losing them. Pro auto-alarms your whole week. Your calendar data never leaves your device. Never be late again.

raw_posts.name: Kabza
raw_posts.tagline: Take over a real city map with your friends
raw_posts.description: Turn Noida, Delhi, Gurugram or Bengaluru into a battle with friends. Drag to send supporters, capture territory and hold 75% of the map to win. Play solo against bots or in a room of up to 8. Free in your browser. No download or account needed.

raw_posts.name: Marked Share
raw_posts.tagline: Markdown and TextBundle editing, review, and sharing
raw_posts.description: Marked Share is a subproduct of Marked 3, but doesn't require Marked to use. It's a free way to share Markdown and TextBundle documents with images and attachments, allow others to highlight and comment on them, and can even publish "blog" feeds with RSS/Atom and Micro.blog integration. Built in editor, or a full API for integrating with your favorite editor/tool.

raw_posts.name: DockFix 5.0
raw_posts.tagline: Replace the macOS Dock with one that is truly yours.
raw_posts.description: Replace the macOS Dock with one that is truly yours. Custom colors, icons and animations, plus widgets, window previews and a file shelf.

raw_posts.name: Wokyintosh
raw_posts.tagline: Turn a spare Mac display into a retro system dashboard!
raw_posts.description: Wokyintosh is a free, open-source macOS dashboard inspired by the classic Macintosh. It combines a large clock and date, local weather, Apple Music and Spotify Now Playing with artwork, plus live CPU, RAM, SSD and network stats. I built it for my Wokyis M5 Retro Dock Station after months of not finding the dashboard I wanted — even among paid apps.

raw_posts.name: Stackness

raw_posts.description: Stackness is where developers and vibe coders show the tools, workflows, and approaches they build with. Build a stack profile you share as one link, post your moves, follow people whose taste you trust, and watch tools rise and fall. Free and with an MCP server.
